title: Dimension
statement: Let $X$ be a nonempty scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Its *dimension* $\dim X$ is the supremum of the Krull dimensions [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] of its local rings $\mathcal O_{X,x}$, as $x$ ranges over $X$. Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. At a point $s\in S$ with nonempty scheme-theoretic fibre $X_s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre], the *relative dimension* of $f$ over $s$ is $\dim X_s$. The morphism $f$ is *of relative dimension $d$* if every nonempty fibre $X_s$ has dimension $d$.
